sheets.name: run_1

sheets.weapons: THE PILLORY AND THE HANDS go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the DARK IRON PILLORY always locked round her neck, BOTH WRISTS locked in its two ends, the hands sticking out; it tilts and turns with her as the pale figure's does. sheets.legs: Frame 1: the legs exactly as the pale figure: one foot planted, the other lifted or swinging. The two legs TAKE TURNS frame by frame as the pale figures show - never the same leg pose in every frame, never both legs stretched apart in every frame; the body bobs with the steps.
